mechanism: Lamotrigine inhibits dihydrofolate reductase, reducing folic acid metabolism and potentially causing folate deficiency; supplementation may counteract lamotrigine's antifolate effects.
action: Monitor folate levels periodically in patients on lamotrigine monotherapy or polytherapy; consider folic acid supplementation (1-5 mg daily) if deficiency develops, particularly in women of childbearing age due to teratogenic risks.
